prompt: How does the producer plan to fit in an equipment check without changing the next programme's start time?
promptZh: 製作人打算如何安排設備檢查，又不改變下一個節目的開始時間？

options.text: End the pledge drive at its usual time and check the microphone after the repair show starts.
options.zh: 募款節目照平常時間結束，等修繕節目開始後再試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 麥克風檢查要安排在兩個節目交接之間，募款節目會提早結束。

options.text: Keep the pledge drive on air and have the next host check her microphone during it.
options.zh: 募款節目繼續播出，讓接班主持人在節目進行中試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 講者要提早結束募款節目以空出試麥克風的時間，不是在募款節目中試。

options.text: Give the incoming host a few extra minutes by starting the repair show late.
options.zh: 將修繕節目延後幾分鐘開始，留時間給接班主持人。
options.whyZh: 要調整的是前一節目的結束時間，修繕節目仍準時在中午開始。

options.text: Finish the pledge drive early and use the gap for the incoming host to test her microphone.
options.zh: 提早結束募款節目，讓接班主持人利用空檔試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 前一節目提早結束，空檔用來試麥克風，讓下一節目準時開始。

evidence: The Saturday repair show starts at noon, just as it usually does. We'll finish the pledge drive a few minutes early so the next host can check her microphone.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

explanationZh: 前一節目提早結束，空檔用來試麥克風，讓下一節目準時開始。
